history.note: Spec needs decisions D1-D3. Architect briefly corrupted core.filemode in .git/config and restored it.

fix/equivalent-direct.title: Equivalent command must repeat the run instead of reopening the wizard

history.note: Reproduced. Spec needs decisions D1-D5. Planner follow-ups at end of run: -l opens the wizard, -l lists only the first URL, wizard drops URLs after the first, ~ in a wizard folder creates a literal directory, --sub-langs doesn't imply -s, cancel exit codes differ, Ctrl-C escapes main, a folder starting with - breaks the printed -o.
